question: Queue item 20261030-1251-expand-dev-services-c696-u04-q01: which Live-environment endpoints of dev-services/stytch answer billing_not_verified until credit card details are added? The error reference of the consumer and B2B APIs defines billing_not_verified for 'this endpoint' and names none. It also defines billing_not_verified_for_email (email only to the sign-up address or addresses on its domain), country_code_allowlist_billing_not_verified (B2B country code allowlist updates) and, under invalid_phone_number_country_code, a credit card requirement for SMS beyond the United States and Canada. A Stytch staff reply of 2024-11-14 on its forum applies the email limit to a Test environment as well. No endpoint page of the docs index (stytch.com/docs/llms-full.txt) mentions billing_not_verified.
why: Which endpoints are gated shows only against a Live project with no card on file: a call to each endpoint of the API reference lists the ones that answer billing_not_verified. That needs an account, so the step belongs to the operator.
